title: Improving Group Robustness on Spurious Correlation Requires Preciser Group Inference
reasoning: The paper focuses on machine learning robustness and fairness by addressing spurious correlations in various datasets. While it uses the CivilComments dataset, which includes demographic groups such as religious identities, it treats these groups as labels for technical benchmarking of group robustness rather than evaluating religion, ethics, or spiritual traditions themselves.
